The '''Ethav Major system''' lay in the [[Ethav Regions/Legends|Ethav Regions]], a part of [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ethav Major [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square P-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
